# 把18年SEO经验和GEO基础整合进Roborank

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-08-11 18:19（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2087121680107798650
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

过去几年，这位客户已经花了超过 €2K，在我持有的多个网站上购买内容营销文章。

我有好几位这样的客户。

这就是我一直在重新整理许多老网站——有几十个——的 SEO，也是我最初开发 Roborank 的原因：

让我能够把花了 18 年学到、已经内化的 SEO 标准，加上新的 GEO 基础原则，用来修改任何 WordPress 网站，我的老网站就托管在上面。

我也在把其中许多网站迁移到 GitHub 技术栈，这样我同样可以用工具修改它们，同时记录哪些做法有效，以便更频繁地重复这些做法。

更多 GEO 流量。
更多 SEO 流量。

一切都在顺利推进。

今天先下 𝕏 了。

附言：AI 悲观论者成不了事。

## 英文原文

this client has spent over €2K buying content marketing pieces on many of my portfolio websites in the last couple of years.

I have a handful of clients like this.

this is the reason I've been reworking the SEO for many of my older websites (dozens of them) and the reason I've built roborank in the first place: 

so that I could modify any WordPress website (where my older websites are hosted) with the ingrained SEO criteria that took me 18 years to learn plus the new GEO fundamentals.

I'm also graduating many of these websites to a github stack that I can also modify with the tool, while keeping track of the things that worked so that I can repeat 'em more often. 

more GEO traffic
more SEO traffic

it's all coming along nicely.

signing off 𝕏 for the day.

ps. AI doomers are ngmi.
